protocol.backend_order: R-first at even source index, prusie-first at odd index
protocol.memory: Separate fresh process per backend, post-fit process HWM before output serialization
protocol.host: Concurrent-load; no quiet-host selection or outcome filtering

R_blas.config: OpenBLAS 0.3.20 NO_LAPACKE DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY Zen MAX_THREADS=64
OpenBLAS 0.3.20 NO_LAPACKE DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY Zen MAX_THREADS=64

definitions.total_time_speedup: sum of all seven retained R fit times / sum of all seven retained prusie fit times on complete positive timing pairs
definitions.geometric_mean_speedup: exp(mean(log(within-case median R time / within-case median prusie time)))
definitions.sum_case_medians_speedup: sum of within-case R medians / sum of within-case prusie medians; separate diagnostic
definitions.memory: independent fresh-process post-fit HWM RSS including interpreter, imports, inputs, validation reference and fit; no subtraction of prior HWM
definitions.inclusion: all complete positive timing pairs, independently of alpha differences, iteration limit, CS presence and memory-mode failures
